title: narcissus tazetta var. primulinus
intro: Narcissus tazetta var. primulinus, commonly known as 'Champagne' or 'Primulinus', is a variety of the tazetta narcissus, a type of bulbous perennial plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its unique, small, white flowers with a delicate fragrance and its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus tazetta var. primulinus are primarily attributed to its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus tazetta var. primulinus include alkaloids, specifically galantamine, which has been shown to possess acetylcholinesterase inhibitory activity, and other compounds with potential therapeutic applications.
